status: Proceed with bounded useful-delivery study and conditional custom-service economics
selection_rule: Choose consequential benefit, available authorized inputs, independently checkable digital outcome and credible complete economics. Technical novelty is optional.
evidence_boundary: The executed public handbook examples are purposive educational engineering analogues. They are not customer orders, scientific-validation studies, or representative demand samples. Their free maintained second edition is a strong buyer alternative. A modeled paid offer applies to customer-specific analyses without an equivalent free substitute; neither discovery nor payment willingness has been observed in that customer population.

candidates.name: Analytical Recovery Capsule
candidates.beneficiary_and_need: Small research and R&D teams with valuable customer-specific historical analyses whose original environment or operator is unavailable.
candidates.useful_outcome_and_acceptance: A runnable notebook/CLI, environment record, frozen inputs, migration diff and evidence; every agreed code cell accounted for, at least three independent output checks, two deterministic clean-process reruns, and no runtime data fetch.
candidates.existing_provision_limitation: RSE consultants, Binder, Code Ocean, ReproZip and MLEModernizer are competent alternatives. The conditional gap is affordable bounded responsibility for small custom cases; execution-only platforms do not automatically establish semantic equivalence.
candidates.why_agent_execution_changes_feasibility: Execution-feedback repair, documentation synthesis and independent checking can reduce repeated engineering effort. This is a commercial mechanism to test, not an exclusive repair invention.
candidates.first_digital_deliverable: Code-only migration of real archived MIT analytical notebooks, with original failures and complete verification packages.
candidates.human_service_reference: Same-scope explicit estimate of 4/8/16 hours. Published rate anchors: Vanderbilt general RSE starts at USD84/hour; Notre Dame external engineering/software USD149/hour; ParaTools USD412.97/hour loaded (USD249 unloaded). These are resource anchors, not exact quotes.
candidates.buying_reason_and_price_range: Avoid diverting scarce analyst/researcher time for a bounded custom recovery. Frozen central proposal USD900 per finally accepted capsule; test USD500–1500. The central USD1192 human reference leaves a conditional buyer saving, while the USD336 low alternative can defeat the offer.
candidates.cheapest_commercial_falsifier: Before claiming demand, an authorized prospect must prefer the exact priced package to a competent free/self-service or human alternative. Technical cheapest test: one admitted broken notebook cannot satisfy agreed checks within capped effort; reject/refund rather than sell an incomplete artifact.

candidates.name: Accessible STEM diagram bundles
candidates.beneficiary_and_need: Blind or low-vision students and disability-support teams needing niche technical figures absent from accessible collections.
candidates.useful_outcome_and_acceptance: Semantic descriptions, editable tactile SVGs and braille-ready labels; correct relationships, units and labels, plus qualified reader comprehension.
candidates.existing_provision_limitation: Established BANA guidelines and APH resources address accessible production. Novel custom content still needs domain interpretation, simplification and reader testing; generic raised outlines are inadequate.
candidates.why_agent_execution_changes_feasibility: A capable agent can infer diagram relationships, construct vector alternatives, cross-check source semantics and package multiple access formats.
candidates.first_digital_deliverable: One licensed STEM diagram rendered as exact vectors, structured descriptions and a semantic map with automatic geometry checks.
candidates.human_service_reference: Transparent unvalidated resource estimate: 10–24 hours for a ten-figure bundle at USD50–100/hour. No exact market quote established.
candidates.buying_reason_and_price_range: Enable participation in a course or technical task; hypothetical USD500–1200 bundle, conditional on reader-validated quality.
candidates.cheapest_commercial_falsifier: One qualified blind reader cannot recover the intended relationships from the prototype, or the buyer already has an adequate accessible version.

candidates.name: Legacy instrument-data reuse package
candidates.decision: Deferred: customer-specific semantics and representative input absent
candidates.beneficiary_and_need: Small laboratories inheriting legacy open-format instrument exports without a functioning vendor workstation or dedicated data engineer.
candidates.useful_outcome_and_acceptance: Analysis-ready conversion with preserved sample identity, units, metadata and value arrays; independent sample comparison or round-trip invariants; explicit refusal when required calibration is absent.
candidates.existing_provision_limitation: Standards and converters already exist. Lab-specific metadata and semantics remain fragmented; format conversion can lose information and cannot reconstruct unmeasured quantities.
candidates.why_agent_execution_changes_feasibility: The agent can reconcile documentation, select existing parsers, build a narrow adapter, verify samples and document the reuse boundary.
candidates.first_digital_deliverable: A single supported public spectral fixture converted to an analysis-ready package with numerical and metadata checks.
candidates.human_service_reference: Transparent unvalidated estimate: 8–24 hours at USD80–150/hour. No exact service quotation established.
candidates.buying_reason_and_price_range: Reuse existing experimental assets without a full migration engagement; hypothetical USD700–2000 for bounded supported scope.
candidates.cheapest_commercial_falsifier: A representative file lacks units or calibration required for the promised use. NIST SRD35 warns its relative gas-phase spectra support identification, not molar quantitative analysis.
